dispositions.rationale: This is a successful verification note plus unrelated local Xcode environment warnings, not a product or repository defect requiring a patch.
dispositions.observation: The targeted `xcodebuild` run passed all 9 `PoolDerivePushTests` with 0 failures. Xcode emitted unrelated environment warnings about `com.apple.linkd.autoShortcut` and absent optional pet sprite sheets.

dispositions.rationale: Commit 894e2c70 updated FloatingPetPromptCapabilities.hasActiveSession to document folded plain-origin and Combined windows as real backing-session capabilities.
dispositions.observation: `FloatingPetPromptCapabilities.hasActiveSession` still documents “actual session-keyed window,” which is now stale because folded origin and Combined windows intentionally qualify.

dispositions.rationale: Commit 894e2c70 added FloatingPetPanelController.currentHasActiveSession, updates it in applyHasActiveSession, and reapplies it when rebuilding the interaction content view.
dispositions.observation: The Own controller stores capability only on its current interaction view, unlike the Minimalist badge view’s retained property. Current spawn ordering makes this work, but retaining the value in `FloatingPetPanelController` would prevent a future content-view rebuild from reverting capability to `currentSessionNumber != nil`.
